en.summary: This commit fixes non-cacheable bypass response routing by recomputing the requester-valid onehot from each returning response tag instead of initializing it once as a state variable.
why_it_counts: It changes active cache-bypass RTL on the response path back to the core.
The modified signal directly decides which requester sees a returning non-cacheable response.
The patch is a localized logic correction with a clear reverse mutation.
evidence: rsp_nc_valid_r changes from a reg declaration with an initializer to a wire continuous assignment.
rsp_idx is decoded from the returning response tag, and core_rsp_in_valid[i] ORs rsp_nc_valid_r[i] into the per-requester response valid.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a cache-bypass path that demultiplexes non-cacheable memory responses back to one of several requesters, the response-valid onehot must be derived from the current response tag every cycle. If that onehot is implemented as an initialization-time or stale state variable instead of live combinational decode, later responses can be delivered to the wrong requester or not asserted at all.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A bypass or non-cacheable response returns while the originating requester index can vary across transactions.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace the live requester-index decode with a stale initialized or latched onehot valid mask.
portability_notes: Apply this to the logic that converts a returned response tag into a requester-select valid vector.
The bug is easiest to observe when multiple request sources share one bypassed memory return path.
The mutation should affect only the response-valid demux, not the response data payload itself.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the response tag bits that encode the originating requester or lane.
Find the onehot or valid-mask logic that raises response_valid for that requester.
Change that logic from continuous combinational decode to a declaration-time initializer, stale register, or otherwise non-updating state.
Leave the downstream response mux unchanged so it still trusts the corrupted valid vector.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_cache_bypass core response valid routing for bypassed non-cacheable responses
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changed rsp_nc_valid_r from an initialized reg to a wire assignment driven by is_mem_rsp_nc and rsp_idx so the selected requester updates with each returning response.
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: replace continuous decode with initialized variable
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bypass.sv, revert rsp_nc_valid_r to a declaration-time initialized variable instead of a wire assignment.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Returning non-cacheable responses are dropped or reported to the wrong requester, causing missing completions or misrouted data on the bypass path.
evidence_for_injection: The response requester index rsp_idx is derived from the incoming memory response tag.
rsp_nc_valid_r is the only changed signal and directly feeds core_rsp_in_valid.
Using a wire instead of a reg initializer is the semantic difference between live decode and stale value.
notes: The bug is only observable on the non-cacheable or bypass return path.
It is most visible when different requesters issue back-to-back bypassed accesses.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了非缓存旁路响应的路由问题：响应返回时应根据当前 tag 重新计算请求者 onehot valid，而不是把它做成只初始化一次的状态变量。
why_it_counts: 它修改了缓存旁路到核心返回路径上的实际 RTL 逻辑。
被修改的信号直接决定哪个请求者会看到返回的非缓存响应。
该补丁是局部且可明确反向注入的逻辑修复。
evidence: rsp_nc_valid_r 从带初始化表达式的 reg 声明改成了 wire 连续赋值。
rsp_idx 由返回响应 tag 解码得到，而 core_rsp_in_valid[i] 会把 rsp_nc_valid_r[i] 并入每个请求者的响应 valid。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在把非缓存内存响应按 tag 分发回多个请求者的 cache-bypass 路径中，响应 valid 的 onehot 必须每个周期根据当前返回 tag 重新解码。如果这个 onehot 不是组合解码，而是做成初始化时求值或会陈旧的状态变量，那么后续响应就可能发给错误的请求者，或者根本不拉起 valid。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当旁路或非缓存响应返回，且事务来源请求者会在不同访问之间变化时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把实时的请求者索引解码替换成陈旧的初始化值或锁存的 onehot valid mask。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 冻结 onehot 响应选择器
portability_notes: 把故障注入在“由返回响应 tag 生成请求者选择 valid 向量”的逻辑上。
当多个请求源共享同一条旁路返回路径时最容易观察到该错误。
应只破坏响应 valid 分发，不要修改响应数据本身。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位返回响应 tag 中用于编码来源请求者或 lane 的比特。
找到根据该索引生成 response_valid onehot 或 valid mask 的逻辑。
把该逻辑从持续更新的组合解码改成声明时初始化、陈旧寄存器或其他不会实时更新的状态。
保持下游响应 mux 不变，让它继续信任这个被破坏的 valid 向量。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_cache_bypass 中针对旁路非缓存响应的核心侧 valid 路由
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 rsp_nc_valid_r 从初始化 reg 改成由 is_mem_rsp_nc 和 rsp_idx 驱动的 wire 赋值，使请求者选择能随每次返回响应实时更新。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 把连续解码改回初始化变量
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bypass.sv 中，把 rsp_nc_valid_r 改回声明时初始化的变量，而不是 wire 赋值。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 返回的非缓存响应会被丢弃，或者被报告给错误的请求者，导致旁路路径上完成事件缺失或数据路由错误。
evidence_for_injection: 响应来源请求者索引 rsp_idx 直接由返回的内存响应 tag 解码得到。
rsp_nc_valid_r 是该提交中唯一改动且直接驱动 core_rsp_in_valid 的信号。
wire 与 reg 初始化的区别，正好对应“实时解码”和“陈旧值”两种语义。
notes: 该故障只会在非缓存或 bypass 返回路径上显现。
当不同请求者连续发起旁路访问时最容易复现。
